page.overview:
Who is Anton Tolliver?

Anton Tolliver was a soldier of House Atreides.

Anton Tolliver fought as a soldier of House Atreides in the War of Assassins. During the conflict, he developed a rivalry with Maxim Kazmir, an intelligence agent of House Harkonnen. He was assigned a mission by Duke Leto Atreides in which he was station in The Anvil Tradepost.

Tolliver approached Kazmir and informed him that a cousin of his had died. He was disgusted by Kazmir's nonchalant reaction and stated that he would be stuck there forever, as even his own Harkonnen masters despised him. They almost attacked each other until Tyg Rolsum and reminded them of the laws of Kanly. He was approached by the Prisoner and informed them of his mission. He asked them to locate an undercover agent of House Atreides who had gone missing and whom he believed Kazmir was searching for, requesting that they discover what became of him. He provided them with coordinates of his location and warned them that they would have to do a lot of climing.
